examined_formations.title: KOREAN_EXPORTER_CARBON_DATA_REQUEST_CASCADE_AND_MANUAL_REKEYING
examined_formations.chinese_title: 韩国出口企业碳数据请求级联与重复手工重录
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A 2026 KCCI/KICOX survey of 300 Korean exporters reports 99.3% have already been asked or expect to be asked by customers for carbon-emissions data.
90.3% already require or plan to require the same data from their own suppliers, showing the request is cascading down the supply chain rather than remaining a one-off compliance task.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: 66.3% report fragmented in-house systems without a shared standard platform.
42.4% reprocess and re-enter data using spreadsheets or handwritten documents.
38.8% fill customer-specific templates, creating repeated transformation work for substantially similar data.
economic_signal: 64.0% cite system build/integration cost as the leading adoption barrier and 62.7% cite lack of staff/time.
44.7% expect to spend KRW 10-50 million on carbon-data management over three years and 43.3% expect KRW 50 million or more.
This is stated future/expected spend, not proof of executed recurring payment to a new operator.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: KICOX has already launched an Industrial Complex MRV Platform intended to standardize collection, calculation, reporting and verification for CBAM/DPP response.

Glassdome markets direct MES/ERP integration, PCF/CBAM/EPD/CCF workflows and Catena-X-certified data exchange, and in 2026 is operating a multi-tier Korean automotive PCF exchange with KGM/LG Electronics and suppliers.
Catena-X/Cofinity-X provides a standardized cross-company data-space/control surface in automotive supply chains.

examined_formations.title: FRANCE_2026_B2B_EINVOICE_MANDATORY_RECEIVE_AND_PLATFORM_SWITCH
examined_formations.chinese_title: 法国 2026 B2B 电子发票强制接收与平台切换
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: France's B2B electronic-invoicing reform entered into force on 1 September 2026.
All businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices; large and mid-sized businesses must also issue electronic invoices and transmit e-reporting data from that date.
The French government states that more than 10 million economic actors are affected.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Businesses must designate an accredited platform for receiving/issuing invoices or use a compatible solution connected through one.

The government explicitly adopted a tolerance-oriented launch posture for companies encountering difficulties at the 1 September start, proving real transition friction without converting that friction into a new operator asset.
economic_signal: The operating model requires businesses to select private state-accredited platforms, so money motion is expected to land on regulated platform providers and compatible accounting/invoicing software.
This scan does not infer a new payer beyond that mandated platform relationship.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: French rules explicitly assign invoice routing, validation and tax-data transmission to accredited private platforms.
The European Commission country sheet reports nearly 100 private platforms accredited by the French tax authority.
The legal architecture therefore pre-allocates the critical routing and compliance control surface rather than leaving it unowned.

examined_formations.title: ENTERPRISE_AI_AGENT_IDENTITY_SPRAWL_AND_UNGOVERNED_ACCESS
examined_formations.chinese_title: 企业 AI Agent 身份扩张与失控访问治理
observed_actor_state_change_evidence: A 2026 Cloud Security Alliance survey reports 82% of organizations have unknown AI agents in their environments.
65% report an AI-agent-related incident in the prior year, including data exposure, operational disruption and financial loss.
Only 21% report a formal AI-agent decommissioning process.
observed_behavior_or_workaround_evidence: Okta's 2026 CISO research says fewer than half of surveyed CISOs can confidently identify where agents are, what they can access or what actions they are authorized to take.
Organizations are applying human identity policies to agents, using shared credentials and managing access ad hoc.
economic_signal: The evidence establishes incident cost and governance priority, but Scan 081 does not treat security concern or planned prioritization as proof of external recurring payment to a new operator.
exact_incumbent_and_control_surface_pref: Microsoft Entra Agent ID is generally available and provides dedicated agent identities, authorization, governance, lifecycle controls, risk detection, access policies and audit logs.
Microsoft documents support for Microsoft and non-Microsoft agent platforms through its identity control plane.
The same current problem is also being directly productized by specialist identity/security vendors whose commissioned surveys surfaced the problem.
